title: Boosting the adsorption and sensing performance of MoS2 for SF6 decomposition gases by non-metal atom doping:a DFT study
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,3021-3033
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08522E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Mamutjan Tursun, Yifan Liu, Abulimiti Yumaier
In electrical power systems, SF6 in Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) decomposes under partial discharge, yielding toxic products such as H2S, SO2, SOF2, SO2F2. Non-metal atom doping enhances the performance of MoS2 in detecting these toxic gases.
